description: Retrieves a list of activity log entries for a specified Calendly organization (requires an active Enterprise subscription), supporting filtering, sorting, and pagination.

action.description: Filters entries by the specific action performed (e.g., 'user.created', 'event_type.updated'). Provide a list of action strings.
action.title: Action

actor.description: Filters activity log entries by the users who performed the actions. Provide a list of user URIs.
actor.title: Actor

count.description: The maximum number of activity log entries to return per page.
count.title: Count

max_occurred_at.description: Timestamp in ISO 8601 UTC format (e.g., '2020-01-02T03:04:05.678Z'). Filters entries to include only those that occurred at or before this time.
max_occurred_at.title: Max Occurred At

min_occurred_at.description: Timestamp in ISO 8601 UTC format (e.g., '2020-01-02T03:04:05.678Z'). Filters entries to include only those that occurred at or after this time.
min_occurred_at.title: Min Occurred At

namespace.description: Filters entries by their category or domain (namespace). Provide a list of namespace strings. Common examples include 'user_management' or 'event_type_management'.
namespace.title: Namespace

organization.description: URI of the Calendly organization for which to retrieve activity log entries.
organization.title: Organization

page_token.description: Token for pagination, used to fetch the next page of results if the collection spans multiple pages.
page_token.title: Page Token

search_term.description: Filters entries based on the search term. Supported operators: `|` (OR, e.g., `user.created | group.created`), `+` (AND, e.g., `user.created + user.invited`), `" "` (exact phrase, e.g., `"John Doe"`), `-` (exclude term, e.g., `user.created -admin`), `()` (precedence, e.g., `(user.created | user.invited) + team1`), and `*` (prefix search, e.g., `user.email_address:*@example.com`).
search_term.title: Search Term

sort.description: Specifies the sort order for the results. Provide a list of sort criteria strings, each in the format 'field:direction' (e.g., 'occurred_at:asc'). Valid fields and directions are defined by SortEnm.
sort.title: Sort

name: list_activity_log_entries

details.description: Additional context-specific information about the activity. Structure varies depending on the action type
details.title: Details

fullyQualifiedName.description: Combined namespace and action in the format 'Namespace.Action' (e.g., 'User.Add')
fullyQualifiedName.title: Fully Qualified Name

namespace.description: The category or namespace of the activity (e.g., 'User', 'event_type', 'scheduling_link')
namespace.title: Namespace

occurredAt.description: Timestamp in ISO 8601 format indicating when the activity occurred (e.g., '2020-01-02T03:04:05.678Z')
occurredAt.title: Occurred At

organization.description: URI of the organization where the activity occurred
organization.title: Organization

uri.description: Canonical reference (unique identifier) for the activity log entry
uri.title: Uri

Actor.description: Information about the user who performed the action

alternativeIdentifier.description: Alternative identifier for the actor, typically their email address
alternativeIdentifier.title: Alternative Identifier

displayName.description: Human-readable display name of the actor
displayName.title: Display Name

group.description: Group information for the actor, if applicable
group.title: Group

uri.description: Canonical reference (unique identifier) for the user who performed the action
uri.title: Uri

Actor.title: Actor

role.description: Role of the actor within the group (e.g., 'Admin', 'Member')
role.title: Role

role.description: Role of the actor within the organization (e.g., 'Owner', 'Admin')
role.title: Role

collection.description: Array of activity log entry objects
collection.title: Collection

Pagination.description: Pagination metadata for navigating through multiple pages of results

count.description: Number of activity log entries returned in the current page
count.title: Count

nextPage.description: Full URL for the next page of results. Null if there are no more pages
nextPage.title: Next Page

nextPageToken.description: Cursor token for fetching the next page of results. Null if there are no more pages
nextPageToken.title: Next Page Token

previousPage.description: Full URL for the previous page of results. Null if on the first page
previousPage.title: Previous Page

previousPageToken.description: Cursor token for fetching the previous page of results. Null if on the first page
previousPageToken.title: Previous Page Token

Pagination.title: Pagination
